comments: Registered as one bank on the footing line: the pivot x is the centre of the footing stones.

The lit crop has the ajar door six source pixels below the footing line and a taller lit chimney (five source pixels); a reviewed sub-crop ends the crop on the footing line shared with the other two. The taller lit chimney sets the shared scale so that nothing is clipped. Nothing is repainted.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the weathered timber and the contour brown: the snap sent the olive-brown flecks (69793e) to a brown (684629) and the dark-green outline ink (182414) to a dark brown (25140b); both are admitted shared inks, no pixel moves or is added.
geometry: The footprint, the door tile and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: day-0, night-0 (shuttered window), lit-0 (amber window, ajar door, amber chimney slit). The crops are tight and separated by empty columns (checked against the sheet's alpha), so none is merged.
